skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: A distance of $185$ leagues is equivalent to how many links? ($1$ league $= 40$ chains and $1$ chain $= 8$ links)
explanation: Choice D is correct. It's given that $1$ league $= 40$ chains and $1$ chain $= 8$ links. It follows that a distance of $185$ leagues is equivalent to $(185 \text{ leagues}) \left(\frac{40 \text{ chains}}{1 \text{ league}}\right) \left(\frac{8 \text{ links}}{1 \text{ chain}}\right)$, or $59{,}200$ links.
